thread_title: sarracenia x readii (golden clone) Southern Baldwin Co, AL
breadcrumb: sarracenia x readii (golden clone) Southern Baldwin Co, AL

posts.body_html:
I suspect this is the result of crossing S. rubra wherryi 'best clone' with a leucophylla from Southern Baldwin Co, AL, but since this is division from a plant grown in the field (from private property, acquired with permission), I don't know for sure "who" the exact parents are. The owner was known to collect open pollinated seeds from all his plants, grow them out by the gazillons, and then plant them back into the field. Anyways, for reference, here's rubra wherryi 'best clone': sarracenia.proboards.com/thread/341/rubra-wherryi-best-clone

Technically speaking, this is quasi-man made because rubra wherryi was introduced into the field where this plant came from. The only truly native species there were roseas and leucophyllas. Nevertheless, for all practical purposes, I'm gonna give this clone location data because from a breeding standpoint, the more information, the better!

Here's the clone growing in the field. yes, it was still there years after the division was taken, but I haven't been there for a long time, so no clue as to how the field is doing today:


It looks pretty dang nice in cultivation, and just like both parents, it produces its best looking traps during the fall. S. readii golden clone Southern Baldwin Co, AL, pics taken 9/15/21:




Brown chicken, brown cow!




EDIT: moderators-please move this to the hybrid section, totally messed that up, haha!
